name: FFS_SCHEDULE_ITEM
description: Contains shifts and non-working time records added to work schedules.

columns.name: ITEM_ID
columns.description: PK.It is an unique ID of this record.

columns.name: SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: It is an ID of the work schedule this item belongs to.

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE
columns.description: It defines if this record refers to a shift or to a non-working time.

columns.name: SHIFT_TYPE
columns.description: Defines a Shift Type. Possible values - regular, on-call.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: It is an interval of dates where this record is active.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: It is an interval of dates where this record is active.

columns.name: SHIFT_ID
columns.description: It is a reference to a shift.This field is only assigned if type of this record is 'working'.

columns.name: NON_WORKING_REASON_ID
columns.description: It is a reference to a non-working reason.This field is only assigned if type of this record is 'non-working'.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: It is a free text description of this record.

columns.name: RECURRENCE
columns.description: It is a recurrence type for this record.

columns.name: WEEKDAYS
columns.description: It is a bitmask that defines the days of week to be selected.This field is only assigned if recurrence is 'weekly'.1 - Sun, 2 - Mon, 4 - Tue, 8 - Wed, 16 - Thu, 32 - Fri, 64 - Sun.

columns.name: RECUR_EVERY
columns.description: It defines a number of days(daily) or weeks(weekly) to skip.This field is only assigned if recurrence is 'daily' or 'weekly'.

columns.name: FROM_DAY
columns.description: It is a period of days of year.These fields are only assigned if recurrence is 'yearly'.

columns.name: TO_DAY
columns.description: Indicates deactivation day date value.

columns.name: DECORATION
columns.description: Decoration options for on-call shift.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the record is logically deleted (Y - soft deleted, N or NULL - active).
